guidance_summary: Q4 revenue projected at $37.5B (+/- 2%), driven by robust Blackwell AI architecture demand.

key_catalysts: Data Center revenue surged 112% year-over-year to $30.8 billion
Massive hyperscaler capex commitments from Microsoft, Meta, and Alphabet
Full Blackwell production ramp underway with demand outstripping supply into 2026
bull_case.topline_growth_highlight: Data Center segment revenue grew 112% YoY
bull_case.bull_thesis: Nvidia continues to set the standard for accelerated computing. The Blackwell transition represents an unprecedented demand supercycle with pristine gross margins remaining above 73%.

key_risks: Gross margins contracted slightly sequentially from 75.1% to 74.6%
Customer concentration risk: top 4 cloud providers represent over 40% of sales
Elevated valuation multiples leave zero tolerance for any Blackwell supply-chain friction
bear_case.valuation_headwind: Trading at ~35x forward sales and 48x trailing earnings
bear_case.bear_thesis: While current numbers are stellar, gross margins are peaking and hyperscalers will eventually rationalize their AI capex. At these valuation heights, any slight margin compression could spark severe multiple compression.
